collections.name: The wedding welcome
collections.description: A light opening before dinner, with delicate seafood, warm pastry and thoughtful plant-based choices. Start with six to eight pieces per guest and keep service moving during photographs.

collections.name: The polished reception
collections.eyebrow: For a room full of conversation
collections.description: Neat, approachable bites for client receptions, gallery openings and networking. Avoid drips, large skewers and complicated service; plan trays around speeches and arrivals.

collections.name: The sunset gathering
collections.description: A fresh selection for yachts and terraces, subject to refrigeration and finishing space. Compact portions and secure presentation help guests eat comfortably while standing.

collections.name: The signature soirée
collections.description: Lobster, caviar and wagyu add a few memorable highlights. For an evening replacing dinner, add substantial bowls or a station and confirm quantities with the chef.

collections.name: The garden collection
collections.description: A complete vegan selection with warmth, crunch, colour and a sweet finish. Seasonal vegetables and satisfying mushroom bites give every guest a considered choice.
collections.pairing: Jasmine, peach and lemon iced tea

collections.name: The celebration edit
collections.description: A flexible starting point for birthdays, engagements and festive gatherings. Adjust spice, introduce family favourites and serve a separate, clearly identified selection for children.
